sourceIdentity: The fixture compiles every repository JavaScript/JSON dependency from the candidate Git tree and supplies candidate settings.json and internals.json to candidate ConfigLoader. Built-ins and node_modules are host runtime dependencies only. The earlier mixed supporting-module run is superseded by this exact-tree run.
stateIsolation: The fixture replaces StateManager.prototype.load only while constructing its disposable instance and replaces that instance's save method before opening its fixture trade. It neither reads nor writes configured persistent trading state.
